title: Integrability of a truncated tail bound
statement: For real numbers $U$ and $T$ with $T\ge 0$, define a function of $t\in\mathbb{R}$ to equal $U$ when $t\le T$, and $4\exp(-t^2/2)$ when $t>T$. This function is integrable on $(0,\infty)$.
